focus: Queries score keys using dot products. Divide the scores by the square root of the key dimension, apply softmax to each row, then combine values using those weights.
excerpt:
Attention Is All You Need. Section 3.2.1, equation (1).
The output is computed as a weighted sum of the values
Equation transcription: Attention(Q,K,V) = softmax(Q*K^T/sqrt(d_k))*V; softmax is applied to each row.
